svg.aria-label: A scan rig. A carriage on a long history rail marks the saved checkpoint slot. A read head sweeps the rail from the checkpoint towards the head slot and drops each matching USDC deposit into a trough. The trough carries the deposits to the creditDeposit gate: new ones fall into the ledger bin and are counted on a dial, repeats are swung into a skipped tray. The checkpoint carriage moves to the head slot only after the sweep is complete.
